# Varizky Naldiba Rimra - Portfolio

> Applied Machine Learning & IoT Systems Engineer based in Malang, East Java, Indonesia. Informatics Engineering from State Polytechnic of Malang.

## Overview
Engineering portfolio showcasing end-to-end applied engineering pipelines:
- Edge Microcontroller Telemetry (ESP32, C/C++, analog sensor calibration, ring buffer failover)
- Applied Deep Learning & Computer Vision (TensorFlow, Keras, OpenCV, YOLO, CSRNet density maps, LSTM time-series)
- Production Geospatial Analytics & WebGIS (BRIN SIMOJANG Brantas early warning system, Leaflet, GeoJSON)
- Web & Enterprise Systems (Astro, React, REST API gateway, Meta Ads API, Google Ads API)

## Key Systems & Projects
- [CatfishCare TFS 2026](https://myprofile-nine-sigma.vercel.app/#projects): National 2nd Runner Up IoT Aquaculture Monitoring System with automated actuator actuation (SK Direktur Polinema No. 27881/PL2.3/KM/2026).
- [SIMOJANG Brantas WebGIS](https://myprofile-nine-sigma.vercel.app/#projects): Applied Research with BRIN (Badan Riset dan Inovasi Nasional) & Polinema for watershed disaster early warning.
- [AlgaSense](https://myprofile-nine-sigma.vercel.app/#projects): Microalgae biomass photobioreactor monitoring system (Finalist TFS 2025).
- [SAIS Aquaculture PKM-GFT](https://myprofile-nine-sigma.vercel.app/#projects): Multi-trophic aquaculture intelligence funded by Ministry incentive (SK No. 40/WADIR.III/KM/2026).
- [Crowd Density Estimation](https://myprofile-nine-sigma.vercel.app/#projects): MCNN / CSRNet neural crowd density map regression for Hology 8.0.
- [Agroclimatology Time-Series](https://myprofile-nine-sigma.vercel.app/#projects): LSTM rainfall and climate prediction for Intelecta Cup.

## Core Capabilities
- Applied Machine Learning & Neural Modeling (TensorFlow, Keras, OpenCV, YOLO, CSRNet, LSTM)
- IoT Firmware & Telemetry (ESP32, C/C++, Sensors Calibration, Flash Ring Buffer)
- Geospatial Intelligence & WebGIS (Leaflet, GeoJSON, Spatial Regression)
- Web & Enterprise Systems (Astro, React, REST APIs, Fastify, Next.js)
